# ghost/deufeitage

Read public German holiday dates by state/year in DeuFeiTage without personal calendar access

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/deufeitage
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/deufeitage open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/deufeitage read_holidays --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/deufeitage select_region --device <serial> --param region=<region>
ghost skill run ghost/deufeitage select_year --device <serial> --param year=<year>
ghost skill run ghost/deufeitage expand_holiday --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/deufeitage collapse_holiday --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the public German holiday table
- `read_holidays`: Read selected region/year and first three holidays; no parameters, cold-safe from HOME
- `select_region`: Select a supported public German state/filter
- `select_year`: Select a currently visible year and verify the native checked year
- `expand_holiday`: Expand an inline public holiday description
- `collapse_holiday`: Collapse an already expanded inline holiday description
